fixed_slot: One canonical claim slot keyed by RUN_ID; unique CLAIM_ID; exclusive create-new through a qualified authoritative store; never replace/delete/reset.
linearization: One serialized authority-bearing claim commit with durable audit event in the same transaction or authoritative committed log. File mirror is derived unless separately qualified as authority.
before_commit: Only healthy authoritative inspection proving no commit may classify unconsumed. A terminal preclaim RUN remains closed; later work gets a fresh RUN.
uncertain_commit: AMBIGUOUS_CONSUMPTION; block execution/replay. Absence on unhealthy/lagging store is not proof.
after_commit: RUN consumed even if operation never starts. Lost acknowledgement may retrieve existing claim ID, never replacement execution.
intent_effect_result: Separate durable intent per mutating action; unknown external effect remains UNKNOWN. Missing result never implies zero or retry.

crash_windows.before_contact: Inspect authoritative state; same RUN claimable only if nonterminal and proven unclaimed.
crash_windows.request_sent_response_lost: Inspect same claim operation identity; block until resolved.
crash_windows.after_intent_or_start: Consumed; preserve observed or UNKNOWN effects.

fencing: Actuator-enforced fencing at every action if stale workers can overlap. Otherwise no replacement while ownership/process state uncertain.
historical_at2: No reinterpretation/reset of frozen @2 fixed lineage claim. Prospective only.
